page_title: EIN 1-1 KOL | Eintracht Frankfurt v FC Koln 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
90+1' Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Marvin Schwabe comes off the line to clear the ball away.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' 1 - 1 Goal! Paxten Aaronson provides Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom right corner. 1:1.
85' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marvin Schwabe intercepts the ball.
82' The statistic for corner kicks – 8:1.
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Paxten Aaronson (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replacing Buta.
79' Problems for Steffen Baumgart as Julian Chabot is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Luca Kilian (1. FC Koln) replaces him.
78' The corner from Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) is intercepted by Marvin Schwabe.
77' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

77' Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
77' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
74' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rasmus Carstensen (1. FC Koln) replacing Benno Schmitz.
74' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Steffen Tigges as he is replaced by Sargis Adamyan (1. FC Koln).
74' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
74' The resulting set piece from Eintracht Frankfurt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
73' The referee signals a substitution. Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) is brought on as a substitute for Junior Dina Ebimbe.
73' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Sebastian Rode (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Hugo Larsson.
73' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Eintracht Frankfurt earn a corner.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Benno Schmitz (1. FC Koln) was quite harsh and Florian Badstubner didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' Jens Petter Hauge (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
67' A substitution has been made. Omar Marmoush goes off and Jessic Ngankam (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
64' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) has tested the patience of referee Florian Badstubner and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
62' Eintracht Frankfurt are seeing far more of the ball now.
60' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) serves up a nice cross, but Marvin Schwabe punches the ball away.
58' Here is a change. Luca Waldschmidt is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Mathias Olesen (1. FC Koln).
58' Substitution. Linton Maina makes way for Faride Alidou (1. FC Koln).
55' The resulting corner from Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared.
54' The referee signals a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.

53' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
51' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
49' Good movement by Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
48' Corner kicks – 1:1.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Dino Toppmoller probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt). He is replaced by Jens Petter Hauge.
46' Referee Florian Badstubner blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) for his blatant foul.
45+1' Dejan Ljubicic (1. FC Koln) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Badstubner had an easy-decision to make.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' 0 - 1 Goal! Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) puts the ball into the roof of the net past the outstretched arm of Kevin Trapp.
43' Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

42' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Florian Badstubner blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for FC Koln.
42' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Kevin Trapp.
39' 4:1 – the total goal attempt statistics.
35' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

35' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Eintracht Frankfurt can continue in their attacking effort.
34' Linton Maina (1. FC Koln) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.
33' Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, FC Koln are awarded a corner kick.
32' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
29' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
26' The FC Koln players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

24' Marvin Schwabe makes a brilliant save! Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by keeper!
22' One of the players from Eintracht Frankfurt times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
21' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
20' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
17' PENALTY APPEAL after Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
15' The possession of the ball – 54:46.
13' The foul by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) was seen by Florian Badstubner who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
10' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
7' Some neat passing and movement from FC Koln as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
4' Flag goes up against Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
2' Eintracht Frankfurt hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. FC Koln will have the kick-off.
Florian Badstubner is introduced as the referee for today's match.
